summary: Two RETURN block examples: simple dest, src and md5sum fields, and a nested packages dict with contains for missing and badversion lists.
questions: What does a complete RETURN block example look like?
How do I document a dict return value with nested lists?

answer_card.title: RETURN block examples
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
RETURN = r'''
dest:
    description: Destination file/path.
    returned: success
    type: str
    sample: /path/to/file.txt
packages:
    description: Information about package requirements.
    returned: success
    type: dict
    contains:
        missing:
            description: Packages that are missing from the system.
            returned: success
            type: list
            elements: str
            sample: [libxml2-dev]
'''
```
